headline: Wall Street and Asia Stocks Plunge Amid AI Infrastructure Concerns
summary: Wall Street indices nosedive and Asian stocks tumble in Japan and South Korea as investor sentiment regarding artificial intelligence infrastructure shifts.
why: Shifts in sentiment toward capital-intensive AI infrastructure can trigger broad sell-offs across major global equity indexes and technology-heavy markets.
why_moved: A sudden reversal in investor perspective regarding the rollout and monetization of AI infrastructure triggered sharp declines in stock markets across the US and Asia.
